title: B2B Lead Tech Stack, Pixel & Decision-Maker Enricher (v24.2)
description: Pilot-ready B2B MarTech & Account Intelligence engine: 3-axis scoring (Account Fit, Technical Opportunity, Sales Actionability), first-party sGTM detection, operational Marketing Buyer targeting, and EU/DE §7 UWG compliance guardrails.

domains.title: Target Company Domains
domains.description: List of company domains or URLs to audit (e.g., breuninger.com, pipedrive.com, vovk.com). Supports bulk paste of 200+ domains with automatic canonical deduplication and holding-level outreach dedup.
domains.sectionDescription: Provide target B2B/E-commerce domains and choose your scan depth and dataset layout.

scanMode.title: Scan Mode
scanMode.description: full_audit: HTTP + Playwright browser rescue (clicks CMP consent banners, captures first-party sGTM network requests) + full OSINT. fast_http_only: Rapid HTTP + OSINT scan without headless browser (ideal for Standby API or high-volume pre-filtering).
enumTitles: Full Audit (HTTP + Playwright Rescue + sGTM Runtime + OSINT)
Fast HTTP Only (No Browser Render — Rapid Pre-Filter / API)

outputView.title: Dataset Output Schema
outputView.description: full_audit outputs all 144 fields (3-axis scoring, full tech evidence JSON, KYB/compliance IDs, OSINT provenance). sdr_compact outputs 46 curated sales-ready columns optimized for immediate CRM / outreach import.
enumTitles: Full Technical, OSINT & Compliance Audit (144 Fields)
SDR Compact Sales View (46 Actionable Columns)

skipUnqualifiedInOutput.title: Exclude Unreachable / NXDOMAIN Records from Dataset
skipUnqualifiedInOutput.description: If enabled, dead domains (dns_error, unreachable, ssrf_blocked with 0 data quality) are omitted from the output dataset so your team only reviews live accounts.

scanContactPages.title: Deep Crawl Contact, Team, About & Impressum Pages
scanContactPages.description: Automatically discovers and crawls leadership, team, about, contact, and statutory Impressum pages (respecting robots.txt) to locate operational Marketing Buyers (CMO, Head of Digital, Head of E-commerce) and corporate contacts.
scanContactPages.sectionCaption: 2. Deep Tech Stack, OSINT & Extraction Controls
scanContactPages.sectionDescription: Fine-tune GTM unpacking, OSINT enrichment, regional phone parsing, and concurrency.

unpackGtmContainers.title: Unpack Google Tag Manager (gtm.js) Containers
unpackGtmContainers.description: Downloads and inspects active GTM containers to detect GA4 measurement IDs, duplicate GA4 tagging red flags, Google Ads AW- conversions, sGTM transport URLs, and agency credits.

disableDeepOsint.title: Disable Deep OSINT Wave (Ads Transparency, ATS Hiring, DNS/TLS, KYB)
disableDeepOsint.description: Turn on to skip secondary OSINT lookups (Google Ads Transparency RPC, Greenhouse/Lever/Personio ATS job counts, DoH DMARC/SEG, TLS X.509, Wikidata, EU VIES/GLEIF) for faster minimal runs.

defaultPhoneRegion.title: Default Phone Parsing Region (ISO 2-Letter Code)
defaultPhoneRegion.description: Fallback country code for parsing national phone formats on generic .com/.net domains when no country TLD or Cyrillic/DACH marker is detected (e.g., US, DE, GB, UA, PL).

maxConcurrency.title: Max HTTP/OSINT Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of domains processed concurrently in the async HTTP/OSINT pool (15 to 30).

maxBrowserConcurrency.title: Max Playwright Browser Concurrency
maxBrowserConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent headless Chromium contexts for WAF rescue and consent-gated rendering (1 to 8). Keep at 2 for 4GB RAM containers.

forceFreshScan.title: Force 100% Fresh Live Scan (Ignore Cache)
forceFreshScan.description: Ignores the Apify Key-Value domain cache and executes a completely fresh live crawl for every domain. Recommended for blind QA tests and fresh pilot audits.
forceFreshScan.sectionCaption: 3. Cache Freshness, Anti-Bot WAF & Webhook Integration
forceFreshScan.sectionDescription: Control snapshot caching, proxy routing, and automated downstream delivery.

maxCacheAgeDays.title: Max Cache Snapshot Age (Days)
maxCacheAgeDays.description: Maximum age of cached domain snapshots used as fallback if a target temporarily blocks live requests (0 disables cache reads; ignored when forceFreshScan is enabled).

bypassHopelessWaf.title: Attempt Playwright on Hard-WAF Domains
bypassHopelessWaf.description: Overrides the built-in skip list for notoriously aggressive enterprise WAF targets (e.g., Zalando, Otto, Douglas). Uses more compute and residential proxy bandwidth.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings for HTTP retries and Playwright fallback. Datacenter or Automatic proxy is recommended; RESIDENTIAL proxy is used selectively for WAF escalation with automatic fallback to standard pool.

webhookUrl.title: Completion Webhook URL (Optional)
webhookUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint (e.g., Make, n8n, Zapier, CRM webhook) to receive a POST JSON payload with run telemetry and up to 250 enriched records upon completion.

serperApiKey.title: Serper.dev API Key (Optional — LinkedIn Marketing Buyer X-Ray)
serperApiKey.description: Optional Google SERP API key to automatically enrich operational Marketing Buyers (CMO, Head of Digital, Head of E-commerce) via LinkedIn X-Ray when only CEO/Founder or no DM is listed on-site.
serperApiKey.sectionDescription: Bring your own keys to unlock automated LinkedIn DM discovery and SMTP-level email verification.

reoonApiKey.title: Reoon Email Verifier API Key (Optional)
reoonApiKey.description: Optional Reoon API key to verify predicted decision-maker corporate email patterns in real time.

millionVerifierApiKey.title: MillionVerifier API Key (Optional)
millionVerifierApiKey.description: Optional MillionVerifier API key used as fallback or primary SMTP verifier for predicted decision-maker emails.

manualSeeds.title: Custom Manual Audit Seeds (Optional JSON)
manualSeeds.description: Optional JSON object mapping canonical domains (e.g., "example.com": {...}) to verified manual audit records used as fallback when a target is completely blocked.
